ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with approximately 15-20% high-intensity pixels (light grey/white) concentrated in mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light grey mottling localized on the distal posterior section of the right lobe; subtle vertical light-intensity streaks observed across the medial span of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations at the distal tip of the right lobe; low-amplitude, irregular peaks distributed along the visible trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the visible trailing edges of both lobes prior to water surface occlusion.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, dark-intensity linear disruptions spanning the width of the left lobe's visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular dark protrusion and tissue irregularity at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced morphological asymmetry between the lobes, characterized by extreme raggedness of the right lobe tip versus the relatively continuous edge of the left lobe.
